data.name: BlastForge– Forge your legend
data.detailed_description:
BlastForge– Forge your legend is a fast-paced tactical FPS built for players who value clean gunplay, instant responsiveness, and fair competitive combat. Every action, every shot, and every movement matters — only skill, precision, and strategy decide the outcome.

Enter a world of intense firefights, carefully crafted maps, and polished core mechanics. From solo training sessions to coordinated team battles, BlastForge delivers a flexible progression system, realistic weapon behavior, and refined movement designed to reward mastery.

  • ⚔️ Tactical PvP Modes
    Control objectives, hold angles, push aggressively, or play strategically — adapt to every situation.

  • 🎯 Clean, Responsive Gunplay
    No unnecessary visual noise. Just crisp recoil, predictable patterns, and fair duels.

  • 🤖 Training Mode & Bots
    Sharpen your aim, explore maps, and master movement before entering real battles.

  • 🗺️ Unique Maps
    Fight across industrial zones, night environments, and more — each built for tactical gameplay.

  • 🧨 Grenades, Gadgets & Specialized Weapons
    Use tactical tools to break defenses, force rotations, and outplay your opponents.

  • 🛰️ Killstreak Abilities
    Earn powerful rewards that can shift the momentum of the match when used skillfully.

  • 👥 Active Development
    New maps, modes, events, and improvements guided by community feedback.

Free For All

A fast and chaotic every-player-for-themselves mode. No teams, no allies — eliminate anyone you see. The player with the most kills by the end of the match wins.

Team Deathmatch

Two teams fight head-to-head in classic combat. Work together, hold angles, control the map, and outscore the enemy team before the time runs out.

Elimination

A high-pressure round-based mode. No respawns — once you’re down, you wait until the next round. The team that eliminates all opponents or completes the objective wins the round.

Demolition

Attackers must plant and defend the bomb, while defenders must stop them or defuse it. Tactical gameplay with strong focus on strategy, utility, and teamwork.

Kill Confirmed

Classic kill collection mode. Eliminate enemies and secure their dropped tags to score. Deny enemy points by picking up tags from fallen teammates.

Airstreak Mode

Earn killstreak points to unlock powerful Airstreak abilities. Use air support, recon tools, or high-impact tactical strikes to change the momentum of the match.

Capture the Flag

Two teams compete to infiltrate the enemy base, steal their flag, and return it safely to their own. Protect your flag, coordinate attacks, and outmaneuver opponents to secure points and dominate the battlefield.

BlastForge is a game where skill, teamwork, and quick decision-making forge legends.
Forge Your Legend.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows-compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400F / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super / AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows-compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended
